story: Red Bull Car Park Drift Jeddah
title: RED BULL CAR PARK DRIFT RETURNS TO JEDDAH

headline: CAR PARK DRIFT
IS BACK IN
JEDDAH
data.body: After four years away, Red Bull Car Park Drift returns to the Jeddah Corniche Circuit. New format: 90 seconds, an open course, obstacles like the Pendulum, Spinner and Figure of 8, bonus for a 360, and the run ends with a stop in the Parking Box. The winner goes to the 2027 World Final in Baku.

caption:
Car Park Drift is back in Jeddah on December 4 and 5 with a new format: 90 seconds, pick your own line through the obstacles, park it in the box. Winner books a ticket to the 2027 World Final in Baku. 🅿️
